cpuAggregator.method: Existing V8 timeDeltas-weighted sample aggregation; no wall-time rescaling. Allocation: sum SamplingHeapProfile node.selfSize; site identity functionName/url/zero-based line/column, scriptId excluded. Statistical estimates include collected objects, not exact allocated or retained bytes.

moduleResidency.policy: Identical balanced parser query and unqueried checker URL in both candidate and control lanes; no per-lane module-cache alias.

cpu.attribution: samples[i] is weighted by timeDeltas[i] in microseconds; no wall-time rescaling or hitCount estimates; inclusive function identity credited once per sample
cpu.functionIdentity: functionName + url + zero-based lineNumber + zero-based columnNumber; process-local scriptId excluded
cpu.gcIdentity: stack contains the canonical V8 (garbage collector) frame; not a guess from heap size or function names

intervals.allocationBoundary: Starts after CPU profiler; stops after CPU profiler. Exact timestamps are not independently recorded.

interpretation.allocation: Estimated allocation totals are lower in all three sampled windows for G30.
interpretation.gc: That particular profiled G30 run has more observed major GC, greater recorded GC duration and larger reserved heap. Used-heap endpoints after window shutdown are close in both lanes; they are not formal post-GC live sets. This does not establish the cause of unprofiled timing or memory variation.
interpretation.profileCardinality: Heapprofile file sizes are not larger in G30; sampled allocation tree/cardinality and depths are recorded, not assumed to explain the difference.

limitations: One paired profiled execution; not performance acceptance or an estimate of the unprofiled distribution.
GC observation/inspector sampling/heap reads perturb the process; profiler stop/serialization may allocate outside sampled windows.
GC entry durations are worker-reported wall durations, not measured CPU or retained bytes; window sums retain whole overlapping events rather than clipping.
heapUsed endpoints are not post-forced-GC live memory; heapTotal is reserved V8 heap, not total process RSS.
Guardian peaks include all phases and profiling overhead. Unprofiled six-run evidence remains separate.
No full heap snapshot, output patch or changed hard limits.

CPU/allocation profiles and profiler-summary GC intervals are not exactly coextensive. Raw CPU includes inspector setup/teardown; never equate its GC sample duration with GC-entry sums over summary timestamps.

methodAudit.verdict: Retain both complete runs as perturbed diagnostic evidence; no demonstrated wholesale invalidity. Correct any claim that CPU/allocation and summary-GC windows are exactly coextensive.
methodAudit.boundaryMismatch: createCpuProfiler starts CPU sampling, then allocation sampling, then records summary startedMs. It records endedMs/memory before stopping either sampler. CPU/allocation/summary-GC boundaries therefore differ; setup/teardown appears in raw profiles.
methodAudit.flushLimitation: setImmediate + setTimeout(0) is a practical delivery drain, not an exhaustive GC completeness proof. Recorded durations are not automatically additive exclusive application pauses.
methodAudit.remainingLaneAsymmetry: Two distinct module instances in both lanes do not prove equal code/source storage or cache sharing: control imports one physical image under two URLs; candidate imports two files. Contribution is unknown.
